tasks.title: Fix 320px horizontal overflow on /privacy and /contact
tasks.description: Two mechanical className additions to kill 320px overflow. (1) In src/components/blog/callout.tsx, on the data-slot="callout-content" div, append `min-w-0 [overflow-wrap:anywhere]` to its existing className. (2) In src/components/contact/contact-form-section.tsx around the email row (`flex items-center gap-3` containing CONTACT_EMAIL + CopyEmailButton): add `min-w-0` to the outer flex; replace the plain `{CONTACT_EMAIL}` with `` that keeps the existing classes plus adds `min-w-0 truncate`. See PRD §Solution and §Implementation Decisions. Do not refactor anything else.
acceptance: /privacy fits 320px viewport with no horizontal scroll
/contact fits 320px viewport with no horizontal scroll
Contact email rendered as real <a href="mailto:…"> for screen readers
tasks.notes: [overflow-wrap:anywhere] on callout content wraps mid-word only for unbreakable runs
